title: Agent reasoning picker
responsibility: Offers the reasoning efforts supported by the selected model in a compact picker.

inputs.name: AgentEffortPicker.efforts
inputs.description: Required effort names in display order. An empty list disables the picker and labels it as using the model default.

inputs.name: AgentEffortPicker.effort
inputs.description: Required bindable current effort. Choosing an offered effort replaces this value and closes the dialog. No fallback is selected for an invalid value.

outputs.name: AgentEffortPicker
outputs.description: Reasoning icon opening a list of effort buttons with the current choice marked. Its tooltip names the effort or model default when no efforts are listed.
